settings.heading: 3M™ Thinsulate™
settings.description: 3m™ Thinsulate™ Insulation Is An Innovative Thermal Insulation Technology Renowned For Its Lightweight, Thin Profile, And Exceptional Warmth-to-weight Ratio.

settings.heading: RDS Down
settings.description: Upholding the Responsible Down Standard (RDS) in our Heated Jacket showcases our firm dedication to ethical sourcing, aligning with global benchmarks for the down and feather industry.

settings.heading: Animal Welfare
settings.description: RDS certification strictly adheres to animal protection principles, ensuring every stage of down sourcing respects animal rights, eliminating abuse from the source, and providing consumers with a trustworthy choice.

settings.heading: Responsible Collaboration
settings.description: By partnering with suppliers, industry organizations, and third-party agencies, we establish transparent traceability mechanisms to jointly oversee compliance in the down supply chain, ensuring the implementation of ethical sourcing.

settings.heading: Social Responsibility
settings.description: We uphold social responsibility standards higher than industry norms, focusing not only on animal welfare but also on improving production-area communities and supporting local economic development, balancing commercial and social value.

settings.heading: Multi-Temp Options
settings.description: The dual-control heating system allows independent or combined adjustment of different body zones, enabling flexible warmth customization for diverse scenarios like daily commutes or outdoor activities.

settings.heading: Comfort Optimization
settings.description: Smart temperature distribution algorithms prevent localized overheating or uneven warmth, maintaining even skin temperature for long-term wear without discomfort.

settings.heading: Extended Battery Life
settings.description: Optimized power management reduces energy consumption, extending battery runtime by 20%–30% compared to single-control systems—minimizing frequent charging needs for extended travel or outdoor adventures.

settings.heading: Dual Control
settings.description: Dual Control Heating System Is A Cutting-edge Heating Solution That Offers The Flexibility To Control Heating Systems Separately Or Together, Providing Customizable Warmth Tailored To Individual Preferences.

settings.heading: BIONIC FINISH® ECO
settings.description: Bionic Finish® Eco, Stands As A Cutting-edge Eco-friendly Innovation, Harnessing Patented Fluorine-free Technology To Fortify Textiles Against Rain And Water-based Stains, Delivering Unmatched Performance.
